violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: spring salad mix 46F* and fresh spinach 45F* cold holding in Avantico display cooler (ambient temperature 50F) in front prep area food prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM agreed to keep fresh spinach and spring salad mix on ice bath until Avantico display cooler is repaired and ambient temperature is at least 41F or below.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: EHS observed multiple food prep employees wearing jewelry (watch and beaded bracelets) on their arms and hands while preparing food on front prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed food prep employees to remove watch and beaded bracelet from arms and wash hands before returning to food prep.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: greens display cooler, 50F and Arctic Air 1 Dr preptop refrigerator, 51F (both front prep area).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: CFM agreed to keep fresh greens (fresh spinach and salad spring mix) in ice bath until display cooler has been repaired to enusre ambient in unit is at lest 41F or below. CFM agreed to not stored TCS food items in Arctic Air 1 Dr prep top refrigerator until repaired to ensure ambient temperature in unit is at least 41F or below. SWEET LEAF CAFE (Inspection Date: 06/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CDI: CFM will discontinue to use the chlorine sanitizer dish machine until serviced tomorrow and will utilize the 3 vat sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize food prep utensils and equipment.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: multiple TCS food items inside of cold hold unit (not maintaining 41F or below at time of inspection) including: cooked rice, pico de gallo, sliced tomatoes, sliced cabbage.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: CFM agreed to not keep food items on time and relocated TCS food items to True 2 Dr UR refrigerator to store 41F or below. SWEET LEAF CAFE (Inspection Date: 12/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): multiple TCS food items inside of cold hold unit (not maintaining 41F or below at time of inspection) including: cooked rice, pico de gallo, sliced tomatoes, sliced cabbage.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. CDI: CFM agreed to not keep food items on time and relocated TCS food items to True 2 Dr UR refrigerator to store 41F or below.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed uncooked salmon filet improperly thawing in uncut ROP packaging inside of True 2 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: CFM cut ROP packaging to allow uncooked salmon to properly thaw.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 Dr preptop open refrigerated prep (45F) and 3 Dr flattop refrigerator (48F) not maintaining ambient temperature of 41F or below.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS scheduled follow up next week.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. Manager holding the ServeSafe certified food manager certificate was not present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. PIC is scheduled to take certified food manager exam on 7/28/2025.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS emailed CFM written procedures for responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed several cartons of Yo cream (premade yogurt mix, 110F) improperly thawing on counter premanufactured thawing instructions on carton for 30 mins. Carton states product should be thawed under refrigeration for 48- 72 hrs.).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: CFM placed Yo cream yogurt mix back in cooler until prepared.
